newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE has busiest ever April, Eurolira sets record.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE has busiest ever April, Eurolira sets record.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Monday it traded 16.02 million futures and options contracts in April, its busiest April on record.
Volume was up 45 percent on April 1996. Average daily volume totalled 728,006 contracts, representing average daily nominal turnover of 151 billion stg.
Year-to-date, LIFFE"s volume has totalled 67.35 million contracts, up 16 percent on the same period last year.
During the month, three month Euroswiss futures contracts set a new daily record of 66,449 contracts on April 9 and a new monthly record of 387,189 contracts.
Three month Eurolira futures set a new monthly record of 1.24 million contracts.
